|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Guild Of Assassins (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Guild Of Assassins (V)]] (original, release sheet of 12 March 2010); [[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Guild Of Assassins (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010; the surviving copy was re-made 4 April 2010): “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aurra, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"; surviving copy re-made 4 April 2010), page 3, slip 309. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 26). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “3-09” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “Aurra” as “Aura” (the list appends the concept credit “(Original concept by Aaron Nelson - Western Nationals 2009)” to the text, as it does for other cards; that credit line is not game text): “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aura, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1263_9-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-guildofassassins-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Guild Of Assassins (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aurra, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “3-09” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Guild Of Assassins (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aurra, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1263-9-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “3-09”). The release sheet heads the slip “•Guild Of Assassins (V)”; the Master List heading prints “•Guild Of Assassins” (a printed-title question already with Bill from Batch T1).
